FAQ

Questions, answered.

What we build, how we work with your team, and what to expect from an engagement or partnership.

Working with Coastline Digital

What does Coastline Digital do?

We are a software engineering and AI consulting company based in San Diego, CA. We design, build, and modernize custom software, AI and machine learning systems, cloud and data platforms, and enterprise applications, and we provide dedicated engineering teams and delivery partnerships.

Who do you work with?

Startups and SaaS companies, growing and established businesses modernizing their systems, technology companies that need engineering capacity, and software consulting firms that need a reliable delivery partner.

Where is your team located?

Coastline Digital is based in San Diego, CA, and works with an international team of experienced engineering professionals. For every engagement, we tell you who is working on your project, where they are located, and how working hours will overlap with your team.

How does an engagement start?

With a conversation about what you are trying to accomplish. We then review your goals, systems, and constraints, agree on the first useful milestone, and propose a team and engagement model. See how we work.

How do you communicate during a project?

You get a named point of contact, a shared backlog, regular demos of working software, and written status updates that cover progress, decisions, and risks. We work in your tools where possible and agree on the cadence at kickoff.

Services

What kinds of software do you build?

Web applications, SaaS platforms, backend systems and APIs, internal tools, integrations, and web and mobile applications. Learn more about custom software engineering.

Can you work with our existing systems and codebase?

Yes. We start with the tools and systems you already use, review code, APIs, and data access, and design changes around your environment. Hosting, access, and data requirements are agreed with your team as part of the scope.

Do you modernize legacy applications?

Yes. We favor incremental modernization, moving one capability at a time behind stable interfaces so the business keeps running. See enterprise applications and modernization.

Do you provide cloud and DevOps work?

Yes. Cloud architecture, infrastructure as code, CI/CD, observability, data pipelines, and integrations. See cloud and data engineering.

AI and machine learning

What kinds of AI work do you take on?

Generative AI applications, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), AI agents, document and data extraction pipelines, and predictive models. Each project is scoped to a real business problem and tested against examples from your workflow before it goes live. Explore our AI and machine learning work.

How do you evaluate AI before launch?

We define what a useful result looks like with your team, build an evaluation set from real examples, and measure each version against it. We review the results together and plan monitoring and human review around the task.

Will you tell us if AI is not the right fit?

Yes. Some problems are better solved with conventional software, better data, or a process change. We will recommend the simplest approach that meets your goals.

Engagements and partnerships

What engagement models do you offer?

Dedicated engineering teams for ongoing capacity, project-based delivery for defined scopes, and engineering delivery partnerships for consulting and technology firms.

Do you work with agencies and consulting firms?

Yes. We provide white-label development, technical subcontracting, and dedicated capacity for firms delivering software to their own clients. See engineering partnerships.

How do you handle confidentiality and intellectual property?

Confidentiality, IP ownership, and non-solicitation terms are defined in the contract for each engagement. If you need an NDA in place before sharing project details, tell us when you get in touch.

What do we have at the end of an engagement?

Working software deployed to your agreed environment, along with the code, documentation, and handoff your team needs to run and maintain it. Ongoing support can be planned as part of the engagement.

How is a project priced?

We scope the work around your goals, systems, and the first useful release. Dedicated teams are typically structured as an ongoing engagement, and projects around agreed milestones. Share what you have in mind and we will discuss scope, approach, and pricing with you.

How do I get started?

Use the contact form or email hello@coastlinedigital.net to tell us what your team is trying to accomplish.

Have a question we did not answer?

Email hello@coastlinedigital.net or send us a short note about your project.
